channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Banks & NBFCs in Indian markets. Today: mixed (−0.9).

item.title: [−1] Fed has time to calibrate rate hikes, Daly says
item.description:
Signal: tighter US monetary policy (US). 12 reports from Bloomberg.com, BigGo Finance, Kitco and 7 more. Related: “Fed's Hammack signals support for gradual rate-hike path”. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Banks & NBFCs: mild headwind (−1) — Foreign selling in heavyweight lenders

Why it matters: Higher US rates and yields pull foreign money out of emerging markets, weaken the rupee and push up Indian bond yields.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows −3, Rupee −1, Bond market (G-Secs) −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Nifty Bank, Auto, Realty skid 1% as inflation stokes RBI rate hike fears
item.description:
Signal: RBI tightening (India). 7 reports from Business Standard, The Times of India, The Indian Express and 3 more. Related: “Banks raise deposit rates after RBI's Oct repo hike; lending rates inch up”. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Banks & NBFCs: mild tailwind (+1) — Lending margins widen at first

Why it matters: A higher repo rate lifts loan rates for homes, vehicles and businesses and pushes up bond yields, though it supports the rupee and lenders' margins at first.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −3, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Growth outlook −1, Rupee +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Foreign inflows lift Indian stocks' dollar returns above rupee gains as currency rebounds
item.description:
